svg.title: DMG-D1a cub wing into a trunk
svg.text: DMG-D1a: Cub at 30 m/s, the wing 2.5 m out - from above 0.6 s after the first break; broken by seam, kinked members ringed (10 broken then)
by the end (5 s): first member wing (no seam) (fold); groups wing0L:strut, eng:mount; 25 broken, 6 kink floors, 0 spruce cracks
